title: Gold Medal, SCiUS Forum
subtitle: SCiUS Forum 14th, Thammasat University, Rangsit
text: Achieved Gold Medal for a project predicting KDML 105 rice moisture content. Analyzed data with SPSS to build a regression model and deployed it on a web application (HTML, CSS, JS) that predicts moisture based on density.
